finding: rot_002 (The Breitenbach Plane) and rot_003 (The Westersingel Plane) share one pin (51.9134174, 4.4755315) and both tell the Breytenbach plane: the tree moved bodily in the 1960s from the grass bank to a new bastion in the Westersingel water when the Coolsingel was widened for the metro. Probable duplicate; the LRMB record nr 1684847 (De Breytenbachplataan, history field tells exactly this story, status alive 'in juli 2026 nog steeds in goede conditie') places the single tree at 51.919196, 4.472, 'Westersingel tegenover nr 6 en Station'. The published pin is about 600 m south of it. Suggested: confirm the two are one trunk (rot_003 sources rijnmond 198634 and monumentaltrees overview; rot_002 sources rijnmond 1411866, straatpoezie, fredmarree), keep the richer entry, retire the other as duplicate, and move the survivor to the register coordinate (approximate unless a crown is identified). Also sources: https://www.rijnmond.nl/nieuws/1411866/deze-ruim-anderhalve-eeuw-oude-kolos-in-rotterdam-is-straks-misschien-boom-van-het-jaar and https://straatpoezie.nl/gedicht/graf-van-de-onbekende-dichter/ (Breytenbach named it the monument of the unknown poet at the 1986 Poetry festival). Age disputed: 1860 vs 1883 vs register band 1880-1890.
